answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can act. Identity then costs capital, so a sybil attacker cannot cheaply spawn a plume of clones. Honest agents earn reputation anchored to that bonded key, while cheaters get slashed. Picture every participant on a narrow ledge above a frozen tundra: one dishonest move and the stake drops away. Scarcity of collateral, not scarcity of names, is what makes fake identities uneconomical.
